scope: Frosty global 4287 HZBTestPS explicit mip gather
translation: Pixel shader model 6.1, DXC and DXV validated. vkd3d SPIR-V validated for Vulkan 1.2.
gpu_control: The emitted four-tap gather statements executed in a compute fixture with 8x8, 4x4 and 2x2 R32_FLOAT mip levels and a point-clamp sampler. 64 coordinates including edges and all three mips, 256 sampled values and 768 output guards matched the CPU model on Radeon 1002:13c0 and GeForce 10de:2705.
limitations: The GPU fixture tests the emitted gather in a compute dispatch. Complete HZBTestPS raster output and other sampler modes have not been checked.
